questions.question: How many approaches for neighbouring cards does the page compare?

source.quote: Compare all three unresolved neighbouring-card approaches

questions.question: Under the bounded shared space approach, what happens as two neighbouring cards' pools approach each other?

choices.a: Both stay anchored and smoothly flatten or broaden, leaving a gap between them
choices.b: Only the card nearest the pointer shows a pool
choices.c: The pools deform under repulsion between their exposed contours
choices.d: The pools merge into one shared pool spanning both cards

source.quote: pools stay anchored and smoothly flatten/broaden as their exposed shapes approach, leaving a gap without obvious clipping

questions.question: With the pointer outside a card, where is that card's pool anchored?

choices.c: At the nearest point of the card's rounded border
choices.d: At the middle of the card's top edge

source.quote: For a pointer outside the card, anchor the pool at the nearest point of its rounded border.

questions.question: What does the page say about the activation distance?

choices.a: It is settled at exactly 200 pixels
choices.b: It is configurable, with around 200 pixels as a starting point for comparison
choices.c: It always equals the card's width

source.quote: A configurable activation distance, for example around 200 pixels, is a starting point for comparison, not a settled measurement.

questions.question: Which Next actions can the reviewer choose? Pick every one the page offers.

choices.c: Ship the picked approach to production
choices.e: Keep all three as rendering modes
